title: New Year and Curling
statementMd:
Carol is currently curling.

She has $*n*$ disks each with radius $*r*$ on the 2D plane.

Initially she has all these disks above the line $*y* = 10^{100}$.

She then will slide the disks towards the line $*y* = 0$ one by one in order from $1$ to $*n*$.

When she slides the $*i*$-th disk, she will place its center at the point $(*x*_{*i*}, 10^{100})$. She will then push it so the disk’s $*y*$ coordinate continuously decreases, and $*x*$ coordinate stays constant. The disk stops once it touches the line $*y* = 0$ or it touches any previous disk. Note that once a disk stops moving, it will not move again, even if hit by another disk.

Compute the $*y*$-coordinates of centers of all the disks after all disks have been pushed.

## Input

The first line will contain two integers $*n*$ and $*r*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *r* ≤ 1 000$), the number of disks, and the radius of the disks, respectively.

The next line will contain $*n*$ integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 1 000$) — the $*x*$-coordinates of the disks.

## Output

Print a single line with $*n*$ numbers. The $*i*$-th number denotes the $*y*$-coordinate of the center of the $*i*$-th disk. The output will be accepted if it has absolute or relative error at most $10^{ - 6}$.

Namely, let's assume that your answer for a particular value of a coordinate is $*a*$ and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png) for all coordinates.

## Note

The final positions of the disks will look as follows:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/948fcb53d93866a46a676ebf7919a7a6476bca60.png)

In particular, note the position of the last disk.
statementZhMd:
Carol 正在进行冰壶运动。

她在二维平面上有 $*n*$ 个半径均为 $*r*$ 的圆盘。

初始时，所有圆盘都位于直线 $*y* = 10^{100}$ 的上方。

随后，她会按照从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的顺序，将这些圆盘逐个向直线 $*y* = 0$ 滑动。

当她滑动第 $*i*$ 个圆盘时，会将其圆心放置在点 $(*x*_{*i*}, 10^{100})$。然后，她会推动该圆盘，使圆盘的 $*y*$ 坐标持续减小，而 $*x*$ 坐标保持不变。当圆盘接触到直线 $*y* = 0$ 或任意一个之前放置的圆盘时，它就会停止。注意，一旦某个圆盘停止移动，即使被其他圆盘撞到，它也不会再次移动。

请计算所有圆盘被推动完毕后，各个圆盘圆心的 $*y*$ 坐标。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*r*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *r* ≤ 1 000$），分别表示圆盘的数量和半径。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 1 000$），表示各个圆盘的 $*x*$ 坐标。

## 输出格式

输出一行包含 $*n*$ 个数。第 $*i*$ 个数表示第 $*i*$ 个圆盘圆心的 $*y*$ 坐标。若每个坐标的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则答案将被接受。

具体来说，假设你对某个坐标的答案为 $*a*$，而标准答案为 $*b*$。对于所有坐标，检查程序会在 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png) 时判定你的答案正确。

## 说明

圆盘的最终位置如下所示：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/948fcb53d93866a46a676ebf7919a7a6476bca60.png)

特别地，请注意最后一个圆盘的位置。
